name: Master Deflection (Combat)
body:
You can lower your defenses to redirect an opponent’s attack to another target.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 17, 8th-level duelist

Benefit: Once per round when you successfully parry an opponent’s attack, you can choose to have the attack target an adjacent opponent. The attack uses the same attack rolled that was rolled against your parry attempt, with a -4 penalty. If it beats the new target’s AC, it damages the target normally. When you use this ability, you suffer a -2 penalty to your armor class for 1 round.
